name: %eternalcore_adminchat%
description: Returns `true` if the player has persistent admin chat mode enabled, `false` otherwise.

name: %eternalcore_adminchat_formatted%
description: Returns a localized admin chat status (the same enable/disable format used in messages), based on the player's language settings.

name: %eternalcore_afk%
description: Returns `true` if the player is AFK, `false` otherwise

name: %eternalcore_afk_formatted%
description: Returns a formatted AFK status message based on player's language settings e.g. `[AFK]` or ``

name: %eternalcore_afk_playercount%
description: Returns the total number of AFK players on the server

name: %eternalcore_afk_time%
description: Returns the duration the player has been AFK in a formatted string e.g. `5m 30s`

name: %eternalcore_chat_enabled%
description: Returns `true` if the chat is currently enabled on the server, `false` otherwise.

name: %eternalcore_chat_enabled_formatted%
description: Returns a localized chat status (the same enable/disable format used in messages), based on the player's language settings.

name: %eternalcore_chat_slowmode%
description: Returns the server-wide chat slowmode delay in seconds. Returns 0 if slowmode is disabled.

name: %eternalcore_chat_slowmode_formatted%
description: Returns the server-wide chat slowmode delay as a formatted duration. e.g. `5s`

name: %eternalcore_chat_slowmode_remaining%
description: Returns how many seconds the player has to wait before sending the next message. Returns 0 if the player can chat right now.

name: %eternalcore_chat_slowmode_remaining_formatted%
description: Returns the remaining time until the player can send the next message as a formatted duration. e.g. `2h 5m 3s`

name: %eternalcore_fly%
description: Returns `true` if the player has fly mode enabled, `false` otherwise.

name: %eternalcore_fly_formatted%
description: Returns a localized fly mode status (the same enable/disable format used in messages), based on the player's language settings.

name: %eternalcore_godmode%
description: Returns `true` if the player has god mode (invulnerability) enabled, `false` otherwise.

name: %eternalcore_godmode_formatted%
description: Returns a localized god mode status (the same enable/disable format used in messages), based on the player's language settings.

name: %eternalcore_homes_count%
description: Returns the number of homes the player currently owns.

name: %eternalcore_homes_left%
description: Returns how many more homes the player can create before reaching the limit.

name: %eternalcore_homes_limit%
description: Returns the maximum number of homes the player can have.

name: %eternalcore_homes_owned%
description: Returns a comma-separated list of all homes owned by the player. If the player has no homes, returns a localized message. e.g. `home1, home2, domek`

name: %eternalcore_is_vanished%
description: Returns `true` if the player is currently vanished, `false` otherwise.

name: %eternalcore_online%
description: Returns the number of online players who are not vanished

name: %eternalcore_vanished_count%
description: Returns the number of currently vanished players.

name: %eternalcore_vanished_list%
description: Returns a comma-separated list of all vanished players. If nobody is vanished, returns an empty string. e.g. `Steve, Alex`
